1530408.name: Serial Engine Cannon
1530408.description: Fires a high-temperature railgun that can pierce through cover, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

1530409.name: Head-On Collision
1530409.description: Hurls its body forward and deals damage to all Nikkes, then fires electron cannons at point-blank to deal damage to all Nikkes again.

1530416.name: Sustained Fusillade
1530416.description:
Fires a barrage of missiles, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes. Destroy the parts within the time limit to stop the attack.
Alteisen generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Sustained Fusillade. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1530417.name: Concentrated Fusillade
1530417.description: Fires powerful missiles, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
